summary: Render context helper (stdcall): reads a box center from this+0x2C/0x30/0x34 and combines it with the two 3-vector arguments a2/a3 to form four corner points, writing each to a texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer (0x00558E10) with corner ids 0..3 and returning the last call's result. Debug/visualization rendering path.

operations.description: Read the box center from this+0x2C/0x30/0x34 (a1[11..13]) and add the a3 vector to form corner A (v11,v13,v15).
Write corner A to the texture buffer via PixelWriteToTextureBuffer with corner id 1, using the this+0x0 texture/render handle and the this+0x60 render parameter.
Subtract the a2 vector from corner A to form corner B (v5,v7,v9).
Write corner B to the texture buffer with corner id 2.
Subtract the a3 vector from the center to form corner C (v12,v14,v16).
Write corner C to the texture buffer with corner id 0.
Subtract the a2 vector from corner C to form corner D (v6,v8,v10).
Write corner D to the texture buffer with corner id 3, returning its value.
Return the value returned by the final PixelWriteToTextureBuffer call.
Invoked by sub_4CC970 (0x004CC970) and ParticleEffectPhysics (0x004CCB30) to emit debug/particle bounding-box corners.
